status_note: **Detector v3 candidate vs v2** (dataset v3: emphasis targets at perceptible stress points). Thresholds fitted on T1 only; never retuned on T2/T3. T2–T6 are development texts (T6 was used once for v2, so it is no longer untouched). T3 and T4 are two passages read by the same 19 readers, so they are not independent; T3+T4 can jointly supply two of the required wins in the ship rule. T7 (Speech Accent Archive, Indian L1 speakers) and T8 (Tagore) added after detector v3 was designed and evaluated once; frozen v1 results in results/frozen_v1_2026-10-14/, frozen v2 results in results/frozen_v2_2026-10-14/. An automatic, pre-registered ship rule chooses between detector v3 (phrase channels) and v2.
